title: Fix DOOM wall projection for unsigned angle differences
changes: Restore abs(int) conversion and single evaluation in the payload shim; RV32 O0/O2 regression fails before the fix and passes afterward. DOOM suite: 11 tests OK. Same-camera E1M5 QEMU comparison and four board frames confirm removal of false vertical walls; board blit diff is zero. Evidence: build/doom-debug/fixed-20261012 and build/doom-render-sim-fixed.
